name: My life as a cat
source:
"My life as a cat" is a relaxing, slow-paced visual novel about longing for something different than the modern society and searching back to nature.

Will you have what it takes to survive out in the wilderness, or will you steer towards a not-so-favorable ending?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2663910/]Steam[/url]]
